product_metadata.title: MCEAST 4 Pack Hanukkah Blue Dish Towels Oversized Hanukkah Kitchen Towels Absorbent Winter Holiday Hanukkah Dish Cloths for Cooking Baking, 18 x 28 Inches
features: Unique design: our Hanukkah dish towels set comes in 4 different styles and each style adopts classic Hanukkah-related patterns including Menorah, star of David and dreidel, easily adding a strong atmosphere to your Hanukkah holiday.

Package and size: each set includes 4 packs of Hanukkah blue kitchen towels, which are sufficient in quantity and fashionable, must-have household items for home life. Each Hanukkah kitchen towel measures 18 x 28 inches/45 x 71 cm, large enough to meet your cleaning needs.

Premium material: each of our Hanukkah oversized kitchen towel is made of microfiber and the surface adopts brushed fabric, making our dish towels super absorbent, durable, have no pungent smell, soft, extremely breathable and with a high stain removal capacity, ideal for drying dishes and water stains on the table.

Range of use: you can use these absorbent winter holiday Hanukkah dish towels to dry your hands, dishes, or utensils, which can quickly absorb the dirt and clean your countertops, tables, windows and other items. You can also hang them on the handle of the oven, the top of the countertop, or on the towel rack to decorate your home and kitchen.

Ideal Hanukkah decoration: our Hanukkah blue kitchen towels are ideal kitchen decorative supplies for Hanukkah family gatherings, birthday parties or other occasions in winter. What's more, they are also foolproof gifts for your family and friends.
